newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo down on revised copper trade loss.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo down on revised copper trade loss.

text.p: Shares in Sumitomo Corp were down in early morning Friday trade, depressed by news that the company's loss stemming from unauthorised copper trading was estimated to be larger than expected, brokers said.
At 0029 GMT, the shares were down 26 yen at 913 yen, with a trade volume of 625,000 shares.
The leading Japanese trading house said on Thursday that it raised its estimate of its losses from unauthorised copper trading to $2.6 billion from the $1.8 billion it announced on June 13.
